generator: tools/topic-vectors.mjs via tools/release.mjs (viem encodeAbiParameters + keccak256; the grammars from the NatSpec of src/profiles/TopicProfile.sol)

grammar.word: 1..255 bytes of strict UTF-8; of ASCII only the 39 characters of `wordAscii` (a-z 0-9 - _ .); no scalar of `refused` (so no Unicode whitespace); not ending with '.' (so not '.' or '..'); not '0x' and exactly 40 of 0-9a-f
wordAsciiRulings: James, 2026-11-26: "? # etc shouldn't be allowed as they are literally urlencode protected params. Nothing that breaks URLs. Nothing that breaks OS file paths."
James, 2026-11-26, later the same day (withdraws the OS-path test): "Don't refuse windows reserved names. I only care about URI safety and us having some delimiters we can use for URL syntax"
grammar.wordAsciiNote: the 39 characters never need escaping in a link and leave every delimiter free. The non-ASCII side (`refused`) is unchanged and will be replaced by a generated table in a later release; Windows device names are words
grammar.wordTrailingDot: code 4 refuses a word ending in '.' for link trimming (an auto-linker drops a full stop after a pasted link, so /inc. would open /inc): the tag design session's proposal, not a ruling; it also refuses '.' and '..'

wordCodes.3: an ASCII byte outside the 39 of `wordAscii`

wordCodeUnused.5: once 'starts with ~'; a '~' is now code 3 wherever it stands. The number is left unused, never reused

wordRuleCodes.8: refs present (checked before the grammar); so the leading '-' rule is 9

grammar.wordLeadingDash: code 9 refuses a word starting with '-': it keeps -word free to mean 'not' in EFS link syntax (the founder's test that words leave delimiters free); the tag design session's default applied by the integration owner, not the founder's words. A '-' elsewhere is admitted (a-b, a-, a--b)

pathRuleCodes.10: not exactly two refs and headers
pathRuleCodes.12: the parent is neither topic/1 nor topic-word/1
pathRuleCodes.13: the second ref is not a topic-word/1 record (the kernel refuses it first: E_REF code 2)

grammar.text: 1..255 bytes of strict UTF-8; no C0, DEL or C1 control; no scalar of `refused` classes 2, 3 and 5; '/', '\', U+0020, class 6 (no-break and typographic spaces), uppercase, joiners and variation selectors admitted

textCodes.23: a bidi control, an invisible scalar or a noncharacter (classes 2, 3, 5)

grammar.order: the byte codes (2, 3, 7; 21, 22, 23) are the first found scanning from the start; the length code comes first and the whole-word shapes (4, then 9, then 6) last
grammar.error: E_TOPIC_REFUSED(uint8 code) on a direct call; through the kernel E_REJECTED(leaf, typeId)
grammar.sdk: fold (lowercase, NFC, the SDK's fold rule) and refuse before building a plan; the chain never normalizes

refused.note: fixed at the first lasting deployment of topic-word/1; may change until then (the SDK fold rule is not confirmed). Sorted, disjoint, inclusive ranges

classes.6: whitespace a text admits (Unicode White_Space minus ASCII, U+0085 and U+2028-2029)

ids.path: n = 1: the word page; n >= 2: Keys.record(topic/1, abi.encode(pathId(first n-1 words), wordPage(last word)))
ids.propertyKey: keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256("efs/property-key/1"), keccak256(key))); a label key is propertyKey("label:" ‖ the BCP 47 tag lowercased (ASCII A-Z only), so pt-BR is pt-br)

order: register every word page and path record before use and strictly before the first statement on it (an earlier action of the same publication counts): pages first, then the path records from two words on, then the statements
